node: Substation switchgear, busway, and power distribution
summary: Expanded a focused universe for the substation switchgear, busway, and power-distribution equipment node. The list uses a two-lane funnel: Eaton is included as the obvious high-attention reference anchor; Powell Industries, nVent, and AZZ are included as more node-specific or underfollowed discovery candidates. Powell has the cleanest direct switchgear/backlog signal; nVent gained direct switchgear and bus-system exposure through the Avail Electrical Products Group acquisition; AZZ is a lower-attention second-order/speculative candidate because its historic switchgear/busway exposure appears partly or largely tied to the Avail EPG asset sale, requiring verification of retained economics and current exposure.
